theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → z ∈ Q → ‖z‖ = 1 → ∃ e : Euclid P, e ∈ Q ∧ ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ z e = 0 ∧ ∀ w ∈ Q, w = inner ℝ w z • z + inner ℝ w e • e
